audience: People looking for useful SaaS products
takeaway: Explore categories, inspect a product, and discover its maker.
experience: Curiosity through word and object entrances
Clarity as a collection becomes a category

selection.visualReason: Linear card travel maps to directory membership; the light canvas separates small labels better than the low-contrast atlas. Orange marks the selected product, cobalt marks supporting categories.
selection.musicReason: Cipher is a provisional electronic candidate from the publisher catalog. It has not been heard by the reviewer; suitability and excerpt boundaries remain unverified.

colorRoles.areaIntent: Canvas dominant in catalogue; accent localized to selection and type; dark detail becomes the main reading surface. No full-frame orange sections.

treatments.construction: Ordered lanes become category columns, then a selected card expands.
Distributed spatial field contracts into category columns.
Radial constellation is gathered around a category aperture.
